name: Kill Neon
detailed_description:
Did it fail again? "The doctor took off his gloves stained with blood, and the metal friction sound and sandpaper rubbed against my nerves. Neon Sister's mechanical prosthetic eye flickered in the blue light of the laboratory, and the gears of the old-fashioned clock in the corner stuttered, hitting my tense nerves one by one. The corner of the photo exposed in the gap suddenly exploded in my mind - a little girl with a double ponytail tiptoed to reach the neon sign on the wall, and a gentle male voice came from behind: "Be careful of falling, Xiao Ni
I clenched my oily arm, the metal bones making a gritty friction sound, but my palms were sweating profusely. You said that as long as you complete 108 transformations, you can restore human memory. "I repeated this countless times, each time with a faint expectation. The memory suddenly turned uncontrollably. I saw myself wearing the same necklace as the one in the crack of the drawer of the experimental table, rotating under the cherry tree, and the silvery laughter startled a group of white doves. The next second, the cold surgical knife pierced his chest, and the doctor's face was shrouded in shadow: "Xiao Ni, don't be afraid, this is to make you stronger
Memory? "The doctor suddenly laughed, and the seventeen" me "behind him in the glass jar seemed to be silently mocking. Those are just electronic pulses that stimulate nerves - you have been a killing weapon since birth. "The cold light from his wedding ring on his ring finger made my mechanical heart contract violently. The words' N · H 'remind me of the handwriting in my yellowed diary:' Today is Xiaoni's sixth birthday, and I want to give her the 'Neon Kill' game hall as a gift. 'At that time, the doctor still had a warm smile in his eyes. ​
The alarm suddenly sounded, and the laboratory dome exploded with a loud bang. A man with purple flames burning all over his body fell in front of me, and the mechanical pattern on his neck, which was identical to mine, made the fragments of memory sting my brain again. I saw on a night filled with flames, a man holding me covered in blood rushed into the laboratory and said, 'Brother will definitely save you!' At this moment, the cover of his diary, which was exposed at his waist, overlapped with the words' A birthday gift for Xiaoni 'in his memory. ​
When the man's blade pressed against the doctor's throat, the unfamiliar heartbeat made his chest ache. When the doctor pulled open his shirt, revealing the blue chips in his bullet riddled chest, he said, "You are all replicas of me. And the real neon was dismantled by my own hands twenty years ago." This sentence was like a heavy hammer, but it made more memories surge - I was immersed in the training chamber, and through the glass, I saw the doctor pressing the young "me" onto the operating table, murmuring, "So you can stay with me forever
The man's blade stopped in mid air, but my mechanical fingers uncontrollably grabbed his neck. The retina flashed through the data stream, seventeen "me" opened their eyes at the same time, and the 18th cultivation chamber slowly rose. The gears of the old-fashioned clock stopped spinning, faded photos fell down, and the scene of a young doctor holding a little girl with a double ponytail overlapped with the last scene in my memory - that day, the "Neon Kill" game hall caught fire, and I saw the doctor's twisted face in the thick smoke, with a cold light on his syringe in his hand. Originally, I had already died twenty years ago, and now I am just a ghost trapped in a cycle of slaughter.



playing method
Plot: The plot is full of ups and downs, with a main storyline lasting 3-10 hours. It is suspenseful, thrilling, and constantly twists and turns, making it captivating.
Card Battle: Strategically combine cards, engage in turn based battles with enemies, and strategically match heroes to gain double combat power.
Random Battlefield: Lucky bosses, shops, lucky draws, and monsters of different levels appear randomly on the battlefield, and the strategy is tested by selecting routes.
Hero Recruitment: Recruit a variety of heroes, expand combat teams, and enrich combat options.
Hero Enhancement: By upgrading and equipping heroes, their abilities can be enhanced to make them stronger in battle.
Hero Team: freely match hero combinations, leverage team synergy advantages, and tackle various challenges.
Hero Returning: For dissatisfied heroes, they can be returned, retrained, or resources obtained to avoid waste.
Double cultivation: Practice with female heroes in pairs to enhance understanding, improve strength, and unlock hidden content.
Victory Reward: After winning, receive a large amount of rewards to help the character grow and unlock more gameplay.
Resource trading: Players can freely buy and sell resources, optimize configurations, and obtain necessary items within the game.
Copy unlocking: Unlock various copies as you progress, experience different challenges and storylines, and explore new territories.

short_description: In 3096, the most severe radiation leak ever occurred at a base in the Centaurus galaxy. Infected humans have been transformed into thoughtless attacking species. In order to defend the colony, a massacre of the same kind began. What mystery lies behind this crisis?
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
